title: A Bad Composition
premise: Archaeologists uncover an unfinished musical score written in human blood.
plays_out: Readers compulsively cut themselves to supply more blood; those who finish a section kill themselves after declaring the composition impossible to complete, and performances produce only discord.
resolution: No completed central plot; verified description or explanatory observation only.

sources.evidence_quality: full text (primary SCP Wiki article, including embedded addenda)
sources.ending_evidence: Description: section-completers commit suicide; performance remains discordant.

status_note: Describes recurring compulsion and deaths across anonymous tests, without a bounded developed narrative.

title: The Morgue
premise: A hospital morgue begins producing animated corpses that try to leave.
plays_out: The bodies match cadavers missing elsewhere; experiments reveal that objects sent inside emerge upstairs aged and ruined, while entering humans are absorbed into the morgue and can return as its corpses.
resolution: No completed central plot; verified description or explanatory observation only.

sources.evidence_quality: full text (primary SCP Wiki article, including embedded addenda)
sources.ending_evidence: Addendum 022-002 distinguishes aged discarded objects from incorporated humans.

status_note: Morgue mechanics and explanatory testing reveal are verified, but no sufficiently developed central incident concludes in this record.

title: Knowledge
premise: A miner suddenly invents cold fusion after walking through a spot that grants perfect random knowledge.
plays_out: Testing brings useless facts and devastating revelations; an accidentally exposed agent learns classified Foundation secrets, shoots colleagues, and is restrained, after which exposed staff must be detained indefinitely.
resolution: Verified documented incident or narrative reveal; continuing anomaly may remain unresolved.

sources.evidence_quality: full text (primary SCP Wiki article, including embedded addenda)
sources.ending_evidence: EL-028-1125 records shootings and restraint, followed by indefinite detention rule.

completion_scope: article incident/reveal, not permanent elimination of anomaly
